verses.text: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

segments.text: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

verses.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.

segments.text: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

segments.text: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.

verses.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.

segments.text: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.

verses.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.

segments.text: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.

verses.text: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,

segments.text: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,

verses.text: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.

segments.text: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.

verses.text: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.

segments.text: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.

verses.text: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,

segments.text: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,

verses.text: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

segments.text: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

verses.text: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.

segments.text: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.

verses.text: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
